result.summary: Design artefact src/design/oidcf2-subdomain-routing.md passes all 6 validation criteria. Coverage: all OIDC-F-05 and OIDC-F-06 MUST ACs addressed. No implementation bodies in new module definitions (modification-example snippets for existing files are acceptable). All 7 new/modified files listed with public interfaces. Migration DDL correct (FK targets tenant(id), UNIQUE on hostname). Both fallback paths explicit (no-match default, frontend API failure silently falls to env vars). Testability: endpoint URL, error cases, and observable frontend behaviour sufficient for TEST-DESIGNER.
